title: MoralBench: Moral Evaluation of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2406.04428v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for a myriad of applications, from natural language processing to decision-making support systems. However, as these models become increasingly integrated into societal frameworks, the imperative to ensure they operate within ethical and moral boundaries has never been more critical. This paper introduces a novel benchmark designed to measure and compare the moral reasoning capabilities of LLMs. We present the first comprehensive dataset specifically curated to probe the moral dimensions of LLM outputs, addressing a wide range of ethical dilemmas and scenarios reflective of real-world complexities. translated_title: MoralBench：大语言模型的道德评估
translated_abstract: 在快速演进的人工智能领域，大语言模型（LLMs）已成为从自然语言处理到决策支持系统等众多应用中的强大工具。然而，随着这些模型日益融入社会体系，确保它们在伦理与道德边界内运行的重要性前所未有地凸显。本文介绍了一个新颖的基准测试，旨在测量和比较LLMs的道德推理能力。我们提出了首个专门精心构建的综合数据集，用于探究LLM输出的道德维度，涵盖了广泛的伦理困境以及反映现实世界复杂性的多种场景。这项工作的主要贡献在于开发了用于评估LLMs道德身份的基准数据集与指标，这些指标兼顾了细微差别、情境敏感性，以及与人类伦理标准的一致性。
tldr: 本文提出了首个专门用于评估大语言模型道德推理能力的综合基准数据集与指标MoralBench，可衡量LLM在多样化伦理困境中的道德表现及其与人类伦理规范的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MoralBench, the first comprehensive benchmark dataset and metrics designed to evaluate the moral reasoning capabilities of LLMs across a wide range of ethical dilemmas.
